text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since the
shocking news
broke. It may be due to
nerves, but Эйсин Флэш
doesn't have her
usual vigor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Nice running, Flash. But this one's my
win!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
I started sprinting five seconds later than

planned... What a careless mistake.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I was thinking this while we were on the
track, but
like... You seem kinda off
today.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
You usually zoom past me like a rocket,
but
today you were more like... I dunno,
a can of soda
fizzing out, I guess?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Like, I can't explain it, but there was no whoosh going on. Y'know, like, WHOOSH! ♪
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: No probs.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
And, as a member of the previous
generation, she
has a wealth of
experience. She took advantage
of my
carelessness with ease.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Should I face a racer with even more
experience
than Jordan at the autumn
Tenno Sho...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
She's probably thinking about the
runners on the
news. They're a threat for
sure, but there's
something even more
worrisome than that.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
You'll be fine if you let go of your worries and
simply run.

text_block_list.text:
But if I mistime my actions, it'll create a
chain of
even worse mistakes.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I can't prevail over the others like that.
However,
the same is true if I take no
action... The
probability of reaping
unsatisfactory results is
high.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
In which case, perhaps the race schedule
itself
should be revised.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
The fiercer the competitions I take on,
the more
fatigued I will become.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
For instance, if we remove the G1, which
we know
will be an intense race, then I
would be free to
focus entirely on the
autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
You should be fine as long as you continue to
improve, though.

text_block_list.text: I wonder about that...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: What is it you really want to do?

text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, but please give me a little
time to
think.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Later that night, Эйсин Флэш sends me a
message
with a fully revamped schedule
attached.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I removed the Osaka Hai and spring
Tenno Sho in
favor of G2 and G3 races.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
These changes are to ensure I won't
overtax
myself and will be in peak
condition for the
autumn Tenno Sho...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I summon Эйсин Флэш to my office to
discuss the
drastic—and frankly
self-deprecating—changes
she made to
her schedule.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Why did you make these changes?

text_block_list.text:
I would like to preserve my track record,
so I
decided it would be more prudent
to pursue a
conservative path than to
risk crushing defeat.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Were I to run against senior opponents
in the G1,
I would indubitably become
burdened with
exhaustion and become
more prone to making
mistakes.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
As a result, I could perform
disappointingly at the
autumn Tenno
Sho... In front of my parents, no
less.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And if that is what I'm risking, I'd rather
be more
flexible than stick stubbornly to
my original plan.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Just like you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Your flexible ideas were what propelled
me
forward both before and after the
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: It's a positive change. Right now...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
This is the most optimal race schedule I
can
devise for myself.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
She said it's a "positive" change... but all
it looks
like to me is that she's afraid of
failure.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What she needs now isn't a schedule
change, but
a chance to face herself
without disillusionment.
To do that, she
needs to clear her mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So what is it you wanted to ask me
about?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list:
I wanted to talk to you about Flash since you
know her so well.

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I dunno about that. ☆ But! I do
see her
every day at the dorm!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Which is how I know she's got a lot on
her plate
right now.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
You know what? What Flash really
needs is...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The blue sea and a white, sandy
beach! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
